description: Write to the candidate of one application. It reaches them in Datronis and by email, through the same channel as the workspace; messages that look like job scams (fees, ID documents, off-platform payment) are held for review. Never ask for money or documents. Requires the "employer" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token with the "employer" scope (create it at /app/api-keys/ → Custom → Employer). Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Acts as you: only the companies and listings you manage.

message.description: Plain text. Reaches the candidate in Datronis and by email; checked for scam patterns first.

name: reply_to_candidate
